title: Playwright E2E Suite Plan
description: A structured plan for a Playwright E2E suite so scripts/playwright_e2e_design_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against this skill's Quality Gates.

locatorStrategy.description: The suite's primary locator tier. user-facing = getByRole/getByLabel/getByText; test-id = getByTestId; css/xpath fail as a primary strategy.

waitForTimeoutCount.description: Number of page.waitForTimeout calls remaining in the suite. Must be 0.

assertionStyle.description: web-first = await expect(locator).toX() auto-retrying assertions; snapshot-read = expect(await locator.isVisible()) one-shot reads (always fails).

authStrategy.description: How tests get authenticated: a setup project saving storageState, a full login in every test, or no auth needed.

testIsolation.description: True if each test creates its own uniquely-named data and resets state via API -- no order dependence.

thirdPartyCalls.description: How third-party services are handled: page.route() mocks, provider test-mode endpoints, live calls (fails), or none used.

traceMode.description: Playwright trace setting. on-first-retry is the recommended value.

artifactsUploadedOnCi.description: True if test-results/ (traces, screenshots, videos) is uploaded as a CI artifact on failure.

ciRetries.description: retries value on CI. Should be >= 1 so on-first-retry tracing can fire (2 is typical).

localRetries.description: retries value locally. Should be 0 so authors see flake.

parallelEnabled.description: True if tests run in parallel (mode: 'parallel' within files and/or multiple workers).

shardCount.description: Number of CI shards the suite is split across (--shard=N/M).

p95TestSeconds.description: The p95 duration of an individual test in seconds. Budget is 30.
